_doc: HUMAN-OWNED FILE. No agent writes here. A test asserts it.
This is the benchmark risk is judged against. It is the difference between
an auditable finding and an opinion:
NOT  'the model thought this clause was risky'
BUT  'payment terms of 60 days exceed firm standard of 30
The second can be defended to a regulator, argued with by a lawyer, and
changed by an approved proposal. The first cannot.
The 1x liability cap is not invented. It is stated in the source data:
clause CLZ-2025-0018 carries a review by J. Martinez reading '2x multiplier
exceeds firm standard - recommend capping at 1x total fees'. The remaining
values are calibrated against the accepted clauses in the same corpus and
would, in a real engagement, come from the firm's contract playbook.
Direct edits are possible (it is a text file) but leave no approval record,
so version_history below would no longer match reality.

must_be_limited_to_own_negligence.rationale: Indemnifying an Owner for the Owner's own negligence is uninsurable under most professional liability policies. The firm carries the loss personally.
must_be_limited_to_own_negligence.acceptable_language_example: The Consultant shall indemnify the Owner from claims arising from the Consultant's negligent acts, errors, or omissions.

duty_to_defend_permitted.rationale: A duty to defend attaches immediately on allegation, before any finding of fault, and is typically excluded from professional liability coverage.

fullest_extent_permitted_by_law_permitte.rationale: Open-ended exposure with no stated ceiling; the limit becomes whatever a future court decides.

max_cap_multiple_of_fees.rationale: Firm standard is total liability capped at 1x fees paid. Source: J. Martinez review on CLZ-2025-0018.
max_cap_multiple_of_fees.acceptable_language_example: The Consultant's total liability shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement.

cap_required.rationale: An agreement with no liability cap is unbounded exposure.

max_days_to_pay.rationale: Beyond 30 days the firm is financing the client's project from working capital.

max_retainage_percent.rationale: Retainage on professional services is non-standard; design work cannot be 'completed later' the way construction punch-list items can.

late_interest_required.rationale: Without an interest term there is no cost to the client for paying late.

discretionary_withholding_permitted.rationale: A unilateral right to withhold pending 'any dispute' lets a client suspend payment without proving cause.

min_notice_days_for_convenience.rationale: Below 30 days the firm cannot redeploy staff, and demobilisation costs land on us.

demobilisation_costs_recoverable.rationale: Termination for convenience is the client's choice; its wind-down cost should not be ours.

max_professional_liability_per_claim_usd.rationale: Above $5M per claim, cover typically requires a project-specific policy that must be priced into the fee rather than absorbed.

max_tail_years_after_completion.rationale: Each additional year of tail coverage carries a real premium that must be budgeted.

open_ended_scope_language_permitted.rationale: 'Including but not limited to' converts a fixed fee into an open commitment.
